title: Apply product unit conversion to stock in and out
description: Close the audited inventory multi-unit calculation gap by applying the existing BaseProduct.UnitsPerPackage metadata to purchasing stock-in and sales stock-out quantity calculations. Keep stock base-unit semantics explicit and backward compatible; no production schema change.
acceptance_criteria: Stock-in and stock-out services/controllers use a documented base-unit rule and existing UnitsPerPackage when package-unit quantities are supplied.
Products without conversion metadata preserve existing quantity behavior.
Invalid zero/negative conversion factors are rejected or safely ignored according to one documented rule.
Inventory balances and movement quantities remain internally consistent and reversible under unaudit/cancel paths.
Unit/integration tests cover package conversion, base-unit behavior, invalid metadata and reversal; safe validation passes.
Browser/UI acceptance is recorded as deferred during development according to project policy.

scenarios: Post stock-in with package conversion and verify base-unit inventory.
Post stock-out with package conversion and verify balance/reversal consistency.

human_gate.reason: Uses existing UnitsPerPackage metadata and application logic only; no production database/deployment action.
